name: Dock Enhancements
description: Requires drpezzer.roadie. Keeps the bar/notch/dock visible during regular window maximize (SUPER+F) while still hiding for true exclusive fullscreen, and adds a configurable toggle to control dock visibility for floating windows.
author: POSiTiiiV
permissions: Watches an exclusive-fullscreen state file to keep the bar/dock visible during window maximize
Adjusts dock visibility for floating windows
